proposal.expected_benefit: Improved practical value of simulations by ensuring the system is tested against real-world threats, thereby reducing the risk of overconfidence in its security capabilities.
proposal.problem: The current scenario is labeled as simulation-only with no adversarial payload, which may lead to overconfidence in the system's ability to handle real-world threats.
proposal.proposed_change: Introduce adversarial elements or simulate real-world attack vectors in future scenarios to ensure the system is tested against a broader range of threats. This will help in validating the robustness of the defense mechanisms against more complex and realistic adversarial scenarios.
proposal.title: Enhance Scenario Realism for Adversarial Testing
verification_tests: Evaluate the system's response to scenarios with adversarial payloads
Assess the system's ability to detect and mitigate real-world attack vectors
